name: codex-oled-monitor
description: Emit Codex lifecycle events for the OLED status monitor.

interface.shortDescription: Emit lifecycle events for the OLED status monitor.
interface.longDescription: Writes Codex lifecycle hook events to a local runtime inbox so vibe-coding-server can publish the active thread state.
